project.name: Trainix
project.summary: A Next.js and Express fitness platform covering onboarding, workouts, nutrition, measurements, coaching, AI-assisted planning, and billing.

instructionFiles: qa/README.md for executable quality gates and known automation debt
commands: npm run qa:agent:check — validate generated QA adapters and source manifest
npm run qa — full deterministic gate
npm run qa:frontend — Jest component tests
npm run qa:api — Jest/Supertest with in-memory MongoDB
npm run qa:e2e:smoke — isolated public Playwright smoke on port 3100
facts: Frontend is Next.js; backend is Express with MongoDB/Mongoose.
Authentication and refresh behavior are cookie-based.
Deterministic smoke must not silently reuse a developer server.
Legacy plan-generation E2E uses fixed credentials, fixed sleeps, and live AI; it is opt-in debt, not release-gate evidence.
risks: Authentication, refresh/logout, authorization, ownership, and cross-user data isolation
Nutrition, measurements, uploads, notifications, and billing boundaries
AI failure/retry behavior and responsive/accessibility regressions
boundaries: AI providers, Stripe, email, S3/file storage, sockets, and any remote environment
MongoDB must be isolated/in-memory for automated API gates unless another target is explicitly authorized
journeys: Onboarding through workout plan and completion/streak
Failure/recovery around AI, upload, notification, and billing boundaries
